in_arabic.name: قرأ
in_arabic.long_meaning: القراءة هي فعل يأتي من الجذر القراءة، يرمز إلى عملية فهم و تفسير النصوص الدينية، وتطبيقها في الحياة اليومية، وتمثل جزءًا لا يتجزأ من الحياة الإسلامية، حيث يُعتبر فهم القرآن الكريم من أهم الأمور، ويشكل قراءة الكتب الدينية مثل السنة النبوية جزءًا من الروح الإسلامية، وتشكل القراءة والتفسير أدوات مهمة للاستفادة من المعرفة الدينية، وتعزز من فهم النصوص الدينية، وتعزز من التطبيق الفعلي للشريعة الإسلامية، وتعزز من الروح الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: قرأ
in_urdu.meaning: قرأت ہے جو کے مطلب ہے پڑھنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: قرأت پڑھنا کا نام ہے جو کے مطلب ہے کہ ایک شخص کتب و رسائل پڑھتا ہے، اور ان کی سچی تفسیر و توجہ کی جاتی ہے، پڑھنا کے معنی میں قرآن پاک اور سنت نبویہ پڑھنا شامل ہے، جو کے مسلمانوں کے لیے ایک فرض ہے، پڑھنا کے ذریعے ہم اپنے دلوں کو تعلیم دیں، اپنے وجود کو بہتر بنایا کرتے ہیں، اسلام کی تعلیمات کو سمجھتے ہیں، اور اپنے وجود کو بہتر بناتے ہیں

in_english.name: Qiraat
in_english.meaning: name meaning is the reading of Islamic scriptures
in_english.long_meaning: Qiraat is a name that means the reading of Islamic scriptures, including the Quran and Hadith. It is an important aspect of Islamic practice, as reading and understanding the Quran is considered a fundamental part of being a Muslim. Qiraat also implies the act of interpreting and applying the teachings of the Quran in one's life. In Islamic tradition, reading and understanding the Quran is considered a means of spiritual growth and self-improvement. The name Qiraat is often associated with qualities such as wisdom, knowledge, and devotion to Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The concept of Qiraat, or the act of reciting the Quran and Hadiths, carries significant cultural importance within the Islamic community. Qiraat is not only an essential aspect of religious practice but also an artistic tradition steeped in history and poetic expression. Muslims from all walks of life, including scholars, imams, and laypeople, engage in Qiraat as a means to preserve, transmit, and honor the sacred texts of Islam. It is a cherished practice that fosters a deep sense of connection to the history and heritage of the religion, as well as to the community of believers.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the practice of Qiraat holds immense significance for Muslims as it is the primary means through which the divine wisdom and guidance contained in the Quran and Hadiths are transmitted from generation to generation. By engaging in Qiraat and striving to perfect their recitation, Muslims deepen their connection to Allah and broaden their understanding of His divine revelation. Through consistent and mindful recitation, they not only pay homage to the sacred texts but also cultivate their personal relationship with Allah, foster a strong sense of faith, and seek to live a more God-conscious and righteous life. Furthermore, the richness and beauty of the Arabic language used in the Quran and Hadiths offer a profound spiritual experience, one that transcends the mundane and offers a glimpse into the divine realm.
